data.name: WildCraft
data.detailed_description:
Wildcraft is a sandbox open-world survival crafting game.

Key features:

  • A living world. Animals and mobs grow, die, eat, and reproduce based on their environment to create a working food chain. Take part in an ecosystem that breathes and evolves alongside you.

  • Versatility over quantity. Two instances of the same item may have entirely different stats, completely changing how you use them.

  • Physics-based items. Items obey the laws of physics. Their mass adds real weight to your character, requiring you to carefully manage what you carry.

  • Organic crafting. Crafted gear inherits the stats and behavior of the materials used to make it. This makes every weapon and tool you forge truly unique, giving you endless opportunities to customize your build.

  • Skill-based combat. Face smart, dangerous creatures in a high skill-ceiling combat system featuring attack combos, blocking, and dodging, inspired by Vermintide.

  • Skill tree and unique abilities. Customize your adventure through a unique progression system where XP isn't just a number, it has a physical form that you must carry and store.

  • Build and defend your base. The more XP you hoard in your base, the more dangerous the creatures you will attract. Build strong defenses and fight fiercely to protect your hard-earned progression.

  • Play your way. There are no fixed objectives or guided quests. Forge your own path, set your own goals, and survive on your own terms.
